text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic complete hollow outfit, no person, skin or visible mannequin, pure white seamless background, soft studio light, portrait 2:3, fully uncropped. Garments: Brown short sleeve button shirt over crisp white collared shirt with white rolled cuffs; taupe high-waist wide-leg pleated trousers with long button fly; taupe shoes.. Add ONLY these accessories: A narrow dark brown necktie, tied neatly at the shirt collar.; A medium dark brown soft leather handbag with two short rounded handles and slightly slouchy body.. Use each accessory once. Neckties are tied with one knot and the narrow tail hidden; for sweater layers tuck the long tail under the sweater. No additional accessories or props.
original_prompt: Edit this exact outfit product image. Preserve every garment, color, cut, shoes, bag and trouser chain and white background. Fix ONLY the necktie: it must be ONE brown necktie tied neatly with a single small knot centered beneath the white shirt collar. No two separate dangling strips or two ties. The tie's broad front tail hangs centered on the shirt, its narrow rear tail fully hidden behind it. Keep hollow empty garments, no skin, head, body or mannequin. Full outfit uncropped.
reproduction_note: 根据服装参考生成无人商品展示。遮挡或未展示的细节采用保守补全；文字和品牌细节仅为视觉参考。未进行逐图重新生成相似度验证。
